confidence_notes: Restaurant meal and coffee anchors are medium quality, based on India-wide café and restaurant averages and Udaipur aggregator figures. Beer, cocktail and wine rest on thin, sometimes retail or hotel-menu data. Wine is set relative to beer because no Udaipur wine-by-the-glass data was found. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for a July (monsoon, lower-season) window; no booking pages or current listings were checked. The FX value 0.6720 was taken from a third-party page (ozfinancehub.com.au) that reports it as the RBA 4pm rate for 18 Nov 2026. I did not open rba.gov.au, the RBA page in my search results was an outdated snapshot, and the rate was not verified against the official RBA table, so the FX provenance is unverified.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink anchors use Indian national restaurant and café averages and Udaipur aggregator figures, with a modest tourist-area uplift. Wine is estimated relative to beer. Hotel and hostel anchors are model estimates for a Rajasthan lake-city tourist market in low season, not drawn from live listings.
